title: Chapter 2951 - 177: Debt Collection Killing
content:
Chapter 2951: Chapter 177: Debt Collection Killing

"Shugu Spell... Cause and Effect Locking..."

Inside the towering, vast, resplendent Shaman Holy Temple of gold and jade.

The Big Tiger used its own body to "shield" Mo Hua upon the high seat, its huge head drooping beside Mo Hua’s hand, quietly closing its eyes to rest.

Mo Hua, expression indifferent, slowly opened the Iron Skill Bone—also the Bone Scroll that Ancestor Shubu had presented to him—and silently read.

The Shugubu’s Curse Skills rely on Cause and Effect Locking, killing people without a trace.

But it requires a descendant with a bloodline connection as a "sacrifice," to serve as the stake in an exchange between life and death.

This kind of "exchange" was hardly worth mentioning to Mo Hua.

With the strength of his Divine Thought, whoever he wished to kill, he could simply erase directly.

What his Divine Thought could not erase, this kind of Curse Skill would likewise be unable to kill.

The so?called "Curse Skill" is, in the end, just a kind of "Divine Thought Killing Skill," only that it appears to resemble a "curse."

Yet it is not truly like a genuine "curse," possessing the "rule" power that transcends Cultivation.

At least, the Shugubu’s "Curse Skills" are such.

As for whether there exists any true rule?level Cause and Effect curse power, that will likely have to wait until his Cultivation is higher, when he can touch higher?tier Cultivation Power, before he can know.

For now, the Shugubu’s Curse Skills are sufficient to provide Mo Hua with a reference.

He "buys the case and returns the pearl," discarding the core of the Shugu Spell, and only studying the method of Curse Locking.

Mo Hua, his Divinity pure, his heart like a mirror, had also raised his comprehension of Cause and Effect to another level.

It took roughly the time of a cup of tea, and Mo Hua had already learned the "locking" method within the Shugu Spell to seven or eight parts; then, combined with the earlier "Cause and Effect Line" theory spoken of by Ancestor Shubu, his understanding of the application of this Cause and Effect Locking became crystal clear.

Afterwards, he planned to use "Curse Locking" to lock onto Elder You, to break the Hua family’s game.

This was the only method he had thought of, after long contemplation.

The key to all of this lay with the Iron Skill Bone.

Previously Mo Hua had been able to guess that ever since Iron Skill Bone left the White Bone Tomb, there must be something wrong with him, but he had never figured out exactly what problem lay upon Iron Skill Bone’s body.

Not until the Divinity within his persona oppressed his humanity.

Pure Divinity made his Observation of all external people, matters, and things penetrate to the utmost, every detail laid bare.

Only then did he discover that within Iron Skill Bone’s Sea of Consciousness there was a Remnant Soul of Ancestor Shubu parasitically lodged.

This "reborn after death" Ancestor Shubu had in fact always been lurking by his side, devoting himself wholeheartedly to "serving" him.

It was thus that Mo Hua "extorted" these Cause and Effect secrets and spell points from Ancestor Shubu’s mouth.

In the White Bone Tomb, Mo Hua would still afford him a few degrees of thin face.

But now, with him following by his side, Mo Hua would no longer be polite.

Moreover, looking at it now, this Ancestor Shubu truly knew quite a lot.

He had also revealed to Mo Hua a great secret... Great Wilderness Chugu Life Skill...

Mo Hua’s gaze slightly tightened.

As to whose hands this Straw Dog Life Skill ultimately lay in, that was still uncertain.

But that was a matter for later; the urgent affair at present was still the Hua family and Elder You.

Mo Hua already knew the method of "Curse Locking"; the next problem was to seek out a "Cause and Effect Line," to locate Elder You, and find a way to "knife" this Elder You.

Once Elder You dies, the Hua family’s chessboard in the Great Wilderness will inevitably fall into chaos.

Once the situation is thrown into disorder, he can seize the opportunity to strike, uproot the Hua family’s forces in the Great Wilderness, and completely slaughter the Hua family’s claws and fangs.

Everyone who hinders him from laying this "great game" must die.

Mo Hua condensed the Golden Blade Technique, sliced open his own finger, and used the fresh blood before him to draw a curse sigil in the likeness of a White Bone Mountain Demon.

When the curse sigil was finished, it flickered faint red; a small Cause and Effect "Curse Demon" within was beginning to stir restlessly.

Mo Hua pressed his hand upon the Cause and Effect curse sigil, recalling every fragment of his contact with Elder You, searching within them for a single Cause and Effect Line that could be used to "lock."

But after several attempts, all ended in failure.

Either the Cause and Effect was unstable—the Cause and Effect Line had barely condensed before, without traveling very far, it snapped of its own accord.

Or the Cause and Effect was too conspicuous—just as he tried to lock onto it, it was severed by something.

Either Elder You possessed a Heavenly secret Treasure for protection.

Or else the Hua family’s old ancestor was secretly employing methods to shield this Elder You’s Cause and Effect.

Of course, it was possible both were true.

Those who play chess, especially masters of the game, cannot possibly make a move without performing some measure of "piece?protection" beforehand.

Otherwise, if your chess piece is captured by another, the situation on the board will immediately take a precipitous turn.

Mo Hua had tried for a long time, yet still could not find upon Elder You a single Cause and Effect Line that was both stable and concealed—not easily severed and able to evade the Heavenly secret—to lock onto him; unconsciously his brows slowly furrowed.

After pondering for a moment, Mo Hua decided to continue searching further back.

Since things here in the Barbaric Wilderness were already an "open card," many of Elder You’s Cause and Effects were being protected.

Then he would search even earlier.

He would search back to when he first came to know Elder You.

But as Mo Hua’s Divine Sense traced backward, he suddenly froze, his mind a blank, as if he had completely forgotten what interactions he had actually had with Elder You back when he was at the Qian Learning State Boundary...

Mo Hua’s brows knit even more tightly.

He understood that this meant his "humanity" had already been extinguished to a certain degree; even his past memories had begun to show large stretches of "blankness."

This situation was already extremely severe.

A faint anxiety and desolation welled within Mo Hua’s heart.

Yet on the other hand, he actually felt a trace of "secret delight" within...
